hook: Your Moon is shrinking and wrinkling.
title: Your Moon Is Shrinking and Wrinkling
description:
NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed cliffs on the Moon called lobate scarps. They formed as the Moon's interior slowly cooled and contracted. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Moon #NASA
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no
